source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Frontend for the Energy Performance of Buildings Register: https://find-energy-certificate.service.gov.uk and https://getting-new-energy-certificate.service.gov.uk. The frontend needs to authenticate and connect to the API using EPB_AUTH_CLIENT_ID, EPB_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, EPB_AUTH_SERVER and EPB_API_URL.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official public route definitions and accepted query parameter names for the certificate finder.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: GET and POST /find-a-certificate/type-of-property route domestic users to /find-a-certificate/search-by-postcode and non-domestic users to /find-a-non-domestic-certificate/search-by-postcode. Public GET routes include /find-a-certificate/search-by-postcode using postcode, /find-a-certificate/search-by-reference-number using reference_number, and /find-a-certificate/search-by-street-name-and-town using street_name and town.
